title: fix(scripts): the checklist's line-citation limb refuses the comma form and a tilde range
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMTMjHLabD7ET8s6UeiyXxh)_

Fixes #24894

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`check-platform-checklist`'s line-citation limb now refuses the two spellings the card measured going through: the comma form (`foo.ts,123`, `foo.ts,123-140`) and the bare tilde range (`~7354-7368`). Both arrive as ordinary `line-anchor` findings from the one shared sweep, with the remedy the limb already names (a `file#symbol` anchor or a file-level anchor).

- **`scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, the comma form.** `LINE_ANCHOR`'s separator is now a colon (with the optional approximation tilde) or a comma. It is tight: no space between the path, the comma and the number, so `foo.test.ts, 12 cases` stays a count. Because it carries its own path it is a row for every corpus, not an option, and that was measured first (table below): zero new hits outside the checklist.
- **`scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, the tilde range.** A new corpus declaration, `tildeRangeCitations` (default OFF), and its pattern `TILDE_RANGE_CITATION`: a tilde, two numbers of at least two digits joined by a hyphen or an en dash, no whitespace, left side refusing an identifier character or a colon, right side refusing an identifier character or a percent sign, and the second number not below the first (so an approximate month stays silent). It inherits the path named before it, exactly as the two path-less spellings do. `defineCorpus` refuses it beside a `docProjection` by the same rule that refuses `pathlessLineCitations` there, and the message names whichever option was declared. Line-anchor findings now carry `comma` / `tildeRange` booleans.
- **`scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`.** The corpus declares `tildeRangeCitations: true`. A finding in one of the two new spellings that sits inside a `history` array of an area file, or anywhere in `FOLLOW-UPS.md`, is counted and printed, not judged (`appendOnlyLineCitation`, keyed on where the finding sits; `historyLineRanges` walks the JSON with string state so line numbers survive). It is a filter on the sweep's findings, not a grammar: the source-read pin D2 (no local citation grammar) still holds. ⛔ It is no wider than the two spellings: a colon-form citation in a history row is judged exactly as before. The console line now names the comma form and the tilde range and prints the append-only count (12 on `main`'s ledger).

## Why the shared core and not only the checklist's projection

The dispatch preferred a checklist-only change. That route is closed by this file's own design: the checklist gate carries no line-citation grammar of its own (self-test D2 reds on one), and the shared core's header records the 2026-09-01 ruling 「⛔ Do not fork this file for a second corpus; if a corpus needs behaviour this core lacks, widen the core」. So the scoping is done the core's way: the path-less spelling is an opt-in declaration only this corpus makes, and the path-carrying spelling became a shared row only after it measured zero new hits in every other corpus. The tilde range is its own declaration rather than a third row inside `pathlessLineCitations`, because `check-adr-symbol-anchors` prints that it leaves "the two path-less spellings" unjudged; folding a third in would make that sentence false.

## Corpus measurement (before any shared pattern moved)

Every corpus registered on the shared core, on `7b047b4483`, with the real extractor (tilde range forced on for the measurement):

| corpus | comma form (now on for all) | tilde range (if it were on) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `docs/adr/**` | 0 | 2: one count, one dated read position (ADR-0131) |
| `scripts/**` comment prose | 0 | 3: durations or counts; an approximate month is refused by the ascending rule |
| `packages/spec/src/**` docblocks | 0 | 0 |
| `isSystem` census page | 0 | 0 |
| platform checklist | 11, all in `FOLLOW-UPS.md` | 1, in a `records-forms` history row |

Gate verdicts for the four other corpora are byte-identical in their line-anchor and declined counts before and after (ADR 0 line anchors; `scripts/**` 0, 11 declined; spec docblocks 0 new, 202 declined, 7 residual; census page OK). `check-issue-citations`, `isystem-census`, `doc-line-anchors` and `check-react-page-adapter-contract` import no grammar from the core (`commentProse` / `symbolResolutionClass` only, or a comment mention), so nothing there moves.

## Red-first proof

The same plant, in `records-forms.json` outside any history row: `sql-driver.ts#createColumn ~7354-7368 and sql-driver.ts,7354`, applied and restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, both legs).

- On `main` (`7b047b4483`): `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0 and prints "line citations: 0 survive". This is the escape.
- On this branch: exit 1, and the live control names both: "B5 the live family carries NO judged line citation … records-forms.json:3871 sql-driver.ts,7354, records-forms.json:3871 ~7354-7368".
- On this branch, a comma citation planted inside a history row's `change` text: exit 0, append-only count 12 → 13.

## Gates

Head `35c4358`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands; each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe and all 34 exit 0, including `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, `node scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs --self-test`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` and its `--self-test`, `check-self-test-wired` and `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`. `--ran` reconciliation: "34 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Seven more ran outside the derivation, all exit 0: the checklist's `--self-test` and the three other corpus gates with their `--self-test`s.

- `symbol-anchors` self-test floor 156 → 175 (each new firing spelling beside the silent neighbour that bounds it, default-off pair, inheritance, de-duplication, and the projection refusal for the new option with its data-corpus control).
- Checklist line-citation-binding battery 9 → 18 (D4 declaration; C1–C3, the card's pins through this corpus's declarations; E1–E5, the append-only filter both ways on a synthetic document, its not-wider case included).
- On PR #25323's head (`14056c9`) with this branch's two scripts overlaid: `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0 (329 items, append-only count 12) and its `--self-test` exit 0.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 337 changed lines. `scripts/` gate files publish nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`. No package is touched, so no build closure, package test or typecheck is owed; no test file names either script.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②: no.** The refusal narrows what the QA ledger accepts; that ledger and these scripts are repo tooling, not a published surface, and no metadata author's input changes.
- **Append-only scope.** The exemption covers only the two new spellings, because only they have a measured append-only population (11 + 1). A colon-form citation quoted in a history row is still judged, as on `main` (0 today).
- **ADR corpus, noted not filed.** `docs/adr/0131-…md` line 1174 carries a tilde range (`applyTenantScope (~12016–12066)`), a position dated to `2514d49f3` in its own sentence. The ADR corpus does not declare `tildeRangeCitations` and its verdict sentence names only the two path-less spellings it leaves off; opting that corpus in is a separate decision with a price (2 hits, one a count).
- The attribution block's first line is an HTML comment, which the session requires as the body's first line: a declared deviation from `os-dev.md`'s no-HTML-comment rule (same shape as PR #25323).
- The branch is the harness-designated `claude/project-thread-gdsmhy`, the one the seat's claim names, rather than a `claude/issue-24894-*` name. Work was done in a linked worktree (`../objectstack-issue-24894`).
